title: These Jars Are Dangerous
text: These Jars Are Dangerous. The lids either don't seal at all or come unsealed, the jars break when you pour hot foods (jam in my case) into them, the bands don't fit well and overall, these jars are a case of possibly deadly ptomaine or botulism poisoning waiting to happen. Don't waste your money! I wasted $50 worth of blackberries, $9 worth of Sure Jell and about $5 worth of sugar because of these defective jars and lids. Not to mention the time making the jam. I'm filing a complaint with the BBB to get my money back. Amazon agreed to refund but I'm supposed to return the jars. NO. I've been inconvenienced enough. They need to go in the trash, not cleaned and RESOLD.
